blocks.text: Gonads, auraton mein ovaries aur mardon mein testes, gametes banate aur anterior pituitary ke LH aur FSH ke asar mein jinsi hormones bhi banate hain.

blocks.title: Balooghat (puberty)
blocks.text: Balooghat nau-jawani ka woh daur hai jab jinsi aaza pukhta hote aur sanvi jinsi khasusiyat zahir hoti hain. Mardon mein sperm banna shuru hota, awaz bhaari hoti, seena chaura hota aur jism aur chehre par baal ugte hain; auraton mein haiz ka chakkar shuru hota, chhatiyan barhti aur kulhe chaure hote hain. Adrenal glands bhi thora estrogen aur testosterone chhorte hain, aur auratein bohat thora testosterone banati hain.

items: Estrogen: jawan larkiyon mein kami se jinsi pukhtagi nahi aati; balighon mein banjhpan. Zyadati rahim mein fibroids (ghair maamooli barhao) aur polycystic ovaries la sakti hai.
Progesterone: chakkar mein kami hamal ka imkan ghatati aur jaldi haiz la sakti; hamal mein kami isqaat (miscarriage) ka sabab ban sakti.
Testosterone: mardon mein kami zanana khasusiyat aur mardana banjhpan laati hai.

blocks.title: Khel mein anabolic steroids
blocks.text: Anabolic steroids testosterone ki masnooi shaklein hain. Kuch khiladi zyada muscle, taqat aur bardasht ke liye inhein lete hain, magar khel mein in ka istemal ghair qanooni aur mamnoo hai. Yeh jigar ko nuqsan (hepatitis, jigar ki rasoliyan), dil ki bimari, stroke aur khoon ke lothron ka khatra, jism ke apne hormones ka bigaar (banjhpan, namardi, mardon mein chhatiyan barhna) aur udasi, pareshani aur jarehiyat la sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Chakkar ke doosre hisse mein progesterone naye follicles ka pakna kyun rokta hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh pituitary se mazeed FSH ka ifraz rokta hai, aur FSH hi follicles ki nashonuma karta hai.

items: Ovaries: estrogen (follicle, FSH), progesterone (corpus luteum, LH; placenta). Testes: testosterone (interstitial cells, LH).
Adam tawazun: pukhtagi nahi, banjhpan, fibroids, isqaat, zanana pan; anabolic steroids mamnoo aur nuqsandeh.
